description: This file defines a utility function 'calculateEffectiveBoundaries' that computes effective start and end boundaries for a Blob object, considering optional start and end parameters with validation and boundary calculations. It includes imports from workbox-core modules and exports the function for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: calculateEffectiveBoundaries(blob, start, end)
methods.description: Computes the effective start and end boundaries for a Blob, adjusting for provided start/end values and validating their correctness against the Blob's size.
